items.headline: 西班牙野火12死23失蹤
items.context: 西班牙南部阿爾梅里亞省（Almería）爆發該國史上最致命野火之一：至少 12 人罹難、23 人失蹤。多名罹難者是在燒毀的車輛裡被發現的——他們想開車逃離火場。
items.thread_text:
西班牙南部阿爾梅里亞省（Almería）Los Gallardos 附近爆發野火，至少 12 人罹難、23 人失蹤，是該國史上最致命的野火之一。多名罹難者在燒毀的車輛內被發現，據信是駕車逃離時罹難；當地官員表示其中 4 人可能是英國人。

本則整理自 NPR 與 BBC 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。

items.headline: 古典與民謠專輯評論
items.context: 兩張專輯：馬勒（Mahler）青年歌曲集《Songs of Youth and Awakening》被讚熱情與強度兼具；Wild Gods 的《The Glorious Abysmal》從赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱傳統長出迷幻民謠。
items.thread_text:
專輯兩張。Signum 的馬勒（Mahler）歌曲系列第二輯《Songs of Youth and Awakening》聚焦作曲家年輕時的歌曲，演唱陣容出色，鋼琴家 Joseph Middleton 的伴奏色彩豐富。Wild Gods 的《The Glorious Abysmal》則從赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱與儀式音樂長出來——評論說這些歌「誕生於捶打粗花呢與迷幻旅程」，揭示後搖滾與民謠搖滾的親緣。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:
兩張很不一樣的專輯。古典這邊，Signum 的馬勒（Mahler）歌曲系列出到第二輯《Songs of Youth and Awakening》，聚焦馬勒年輕時寫的歌，評論稱演唱陣容熱情與強度兼具，鋼琴家 Joseph Middleton 給出細膩支撐和一整排的色彩。另一張是 Wild Gods 的《The Glorious Abysmal》：從赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱和儀式音樂長出來的捲軸舞曲與敘事歌——遠處厚重的隆隆聲、手風琴的金屬光澤、一位女聲唱著悼亡的蓋爾語輓歌。評論說，這些歌揭示了後搖滾與民謠搖滾其實靠得很近。

本則整理自 The Guardian 於 2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
items.voice_text: 兩張很不一樣的專輯。古典這邊，馬勒歌曲系列的第二輯，聚焦他年輕時寫的歌，評論說演唱陣容熱情與強度兼具。另一張來自 Wild Gods，從蘇格蘭赫布里底群島的蓋爾語共唱傳統長出來——遠處的隆隆聲、手風琴的金屬光澤、一位女聲唱著悼亡輓歌。評論的結論是：後搖滾和民謠，其實靠得很近。

sources.summary: Rennert/Konradi/Peter/Keenlyside/Middleton (Signum) This collection of songs that the composer wrote as a young man is full of interest and emotion. With Gaelic archival recordings and melodies rooted in Celtic ceremonial music also being stirred into this bubbling brew, these eight tracks reveal the occasional, fascinating proximity between post-rock and folk-rock. sources.summary: Christchurch Mansion, Ipswich While Britain boils in a heatwave, a new exhibition built around the much-reproduced canvas reminds us of the beauty of the natural world – and what we could lose I first saw John Constable’s 1821 painting The Hay Wain as a postcard with cruise missiles brutally stacked in the wooden cart and pointing at the sky. Peter Kennard’s anti-nuke photomontage is just one of the many parodies and travesties this image of a seemingly eternal rustic Britain keeps provoking. A few months ago, a newspaper cartoon depicted a ballistic missile from Iran speeding through Constable’s painting. But when I visited Ipswich to see its Hay Wain exhibition at the start of the latest heatwave it was the climate making a scorching, ironic comment on this temperate scene. Inside this Tudor house, grey, blue and brown masses of rain-promising cloud hung above Constable’s painted Suffolk fields, dappling them with shade. But outside the grass was straw yellow and the landscape around Dedham Vale and the River Stour, where Constable was born and in which The Hay Wain and many more of his works lovingly linger, appeared to have been blowtorched into oblivion. sources.summary: Sublimation by Isabel J Kim; Last Day of a Prior Life by Andrés Barba; Dead But Dreaming of Electric Sheep by Paul Tremblay; The Carrier by Ruth Newton; Time to Burn by Ellery Lloyd Sublimation by Isabel J Kim ( Picador , £1 8.99 ) This debut novel from an award-winning Korean-American short fiction writer is a fantastical reimagining of the immigrant experience. Here, anyone who crosses a border not intending to return creates an “instance”: a duplicate self who continues life at home. Reintegration into one body is possible, but after years of separate experiences, Soyoung wonders if it might be the psychological equivalent of murder. This idea shocks her friend Yujin, who speaks with his instance in New York every day, waiting for him to be granted the dual citizenship that will allow them to share a privileged life between two countries. The story of these two pairs is told in the second person, a destabilising choice that gradually immerses the reader in a world of doppelgangers. As in our reality, travel is hedged around with bureaucratic systems designed to codify identity and control immigration. A brilliantly realised, imaginative and compelling work of literary speculative fiction. Last Day of a Prior Life byAndrés Barba, translated by Lisa Dillman (Scribe, £10.99) The latest novel by the Spanish author of Such Small Hands is a gentler, more unusual approach to the ghost story. An estate agent encounters a child in the empty house she’s trying to sell, and realises she’s met a ghost. The experience causes her to think about her closest relationships and to act in ways she never has before. Knowing it could be dangerous, she goes back to the house, determined to try to help the child from another time who is trapped there. items.headline: 冰河崩解掀水下海嘯
items.context: 一項國際研究發現，全球暖化加速南極冰河崩解，而崩解引發的水下海嘯，在熱量傳遞上的影響已經大過潮汐——它改變海洋的熱量與養分分布，衝擊浮游植物生態系與海洋食物鏈。
items.thread_text:
全球暖化加速南極冰河崩解，一項國際研究發現：崩解引發的水下海嘯威力驚人，在熱量傳遞上的影響已大過潮汐。它改變海洋的熱量與養分分布，除了加速冰河融化，也改變浮游植物生態系、衝擊海洋食物鏈。

本則來自 公視，2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
items.threads_text:
南極的冰河崩下來的時候，海面下也在掀海嘯。一項國際研究發現，全球暖化讓海水和大氣升溫、加速南極冰河崩解——而崩解引發的水下海嘯威力驚人，在熱量傳遞上的影響已經大過潮汐。這些看不見的巨浪改變海洋中熱量和養分的分布：一邊回頭加速冰河融化，一邊改寫浮游植物的生態系，衝擊整條海洋食物鏈。

本則來自 公視，2026 年 7 月 10 日發佈的報導。
